atomic_step.outcome: Open freezes registered producer sources or a no-upstream reason; seats can cite exact named producer words; batch recording is atomic per cell and continues after visible refusals.
atomic_step.practical_value: Completed seat work is never stranded by one ungroundable upstream claim, and no upstream defect enters the critique without inspectable producer evidence.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: The frozen v2 run is unchanged; its 50 captured responses replay with zero model calls into 150 terminal applicable cells and no one-seat cells; no-upstream and source-cited paths pass; both managed installs match.

final_validation.failure_criterion: Any red byte changes, any reader launches, any cell has one seat, or any unsupported upstream defect enters state.
final_validation.operator_path: Replay all frozen v2 reader responses into a fresh declared-source run without launching a model.
final_validation.success_criterion: The red bytes stay unchanged; all 150 applicable cells record both seats; unsupported claims remain visible non-defect refusals.

approaches.hypothesis: A source-cited schema plus one transaction per cell preserves every sibling and makes unsupported claims terminal evidence instead of a run-level failure.
approaches.implementation: Freeze upstream mode at open, show numbered registered sources to seats, require exact source spans for defect claims, and write both seat outcomes or one two-claim refusal atomically.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Larger response schema and per-cell reducer logic in exchange for grounded defects and no stranded completed work.

approaches.hypothesis: Adding producer text to the existing prompt while retaining sequential whole-batch recording is sufficient.
approaches.implementation: Keep late source registration and sequential seat writes; retry or stop when an upstream claim lacks evidence.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Smaller code change, but one refusal can still strand siblings and require repeated model spend.

mini_probes.goal: Declare producer material before reading and contain an ungroundable claim to one fully recorded cell.
mini_probes.practical_value: Completed seat work is never stranded by one ungroundable upstream claim, and no upstream defect enters the critique without inspectable producer evidence.

proof.failure_criterion: Any cell holds one seat, any applicable cell remains unread, or an upstream defect records without exact registered-source words.
proof.success_criterion: All 150 applicable cells hold two seats; unsupported upstream claims are visible refusals; exact named producer words are required for defects.
